method: Same worker/native build; one excluded warmup per consumer; 9 alternating pairs; generated revisit cache disabled; source data offline.
limitations: One geotile per location, one machine; no engine/rendering/imagery or full-world timing.
Urban inputs include propagated missing-lidar/rule-fallback markers; rural/highway timed rows report no input faults.
Online population is not a controlled empty-download-cache A/B benchmark.
